title: Ultra-deep, long-read nanopore sequencing of mock microbial community standards
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x9tfr6n
materials: Lysis Solution from the ZymoBIOMICS DNA Mini

steps.title: Transfer Microbial Community Standard
steps.instruction: Transfer the chosen Microbial Community Standard to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 75 µL of Microbial Community Standard (Zymo Research Catalog #D6300) OR 375 µL of Microbial Community Standard II (Log distribution) (Zymo Research Catalog #D6310).

steps.title: Centrifuge and Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the standard and transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells and Prepare for Lysis
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in lysis solution and transfer to a lysis tube.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 750 µL Lysis Solution from the ZymoBIOMICS DNA Miniprep Kit (Zymo Research Catalog #D4300).
Transfer the resuspended cells to a ZR BashingBead Lysis Tube.

steps.title: Bead-Beat Lysis
steps.instruction: Perform bead-beating using a FastPrep-24 5G instrument.

substeps.instruction: Bead-beat at 6.0 m/s for 2 cycles of 00:00:40.
Remove the tube and chill on ice for 00:05:00 between cycles.

steps.title: Filter Lysis Mixture
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysis tube and filter the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysis tube at 10,000 xg for 00:01:00.
Transfer 400 µL of supernatant to a Zymo-Spin III-F Filter in a collection tube.
Centrifuge the filter column at 8,000 xg for 00:01:00.
Transfer 400 µL of filtrate to a new 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Prepare Binding Mixture
steps.instruction: Combine the filtrate with the supernatant from Step 2 and Binding buffer in a 15 mL Falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: For Microbial Community Standard: add 45 µL of the supernatant from Step 2 and 1.485 mL Binding buffer; mix well.
For Microbial Community Standard II (Log distribution): add 225 µL of the supernatant from Step 2 and 2.025 mL Binding buffer; mix well.

steps.title: DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the DNA using Zymo-Spin IIC-Z Columns and the ZymoBIOMICS DNA Miniprep Kit.

substeps.instruction: Load 800 µL of the mixture onto a Zymo-Spin IIC-Z Column.
Centrifuge at 8,000 xg for 00:01:00 and discard flow through.
Repeat loading and centrifuging as needed to process the entire mixture.
Wash and elute the sample according to the ZymoBIOMICS DNA Miniprep Kit instruction manual.

steps.title: Library Preparation and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Prepare and load nanopore sequencing libraries.

substeps.instruction: Prepare sequencing libraries using the Ligation Sequencing Kit SQK-LSK109 (Oxford Nanopore Technologies) with 1400 ng input DNA.
Load completed library onto the flowcell: 50 ng for MinION or 400 ng for PromethION.
